correctness.rationale: Strictly positive interior coefficients make every norm attaining vector have both endpoints of at least one edge equal +1 or equal -1. Convexity of the union of cube faces reduces the norm-attaining hull exactly to sign assignments with some monochromatic edge. Every maximizing sign vector either already lies in that hull, or is a proper 2-coloring and must flip a nonisolated coordinate; flipping the least |a_v| is feasible and optimal, proving the exact support L(a)-2 min_{v in V+}|a_v|. For nonbipartite graphs all signings are admitted, r=1. For bipartite graphs min≤L/k yields r≥1−2/k, while a proper coloring with active dual magnitudes 1/k realizes equality. Handles disconnectivity, ties, isolates, k=2 (r=0), and every interior weight. Independently enumerated 71 labeled graphs on 2–4 vertices and 40,204 exact integer dual comparisons; finite checks only corroborate the universal separation proof.
